sites.name: M/V HONDIUS
sites.desc: Dutch-flagged polar vessel en route to Granadilla port, Tenerife; ETA 03:00–05:00 Sunday 10 May. Will anchor offshore — passengers transferred by small boat to isolated quayside, then bus to airport. All 147 aboard (87 passengers, 60 crew, 24 nationalities) asymptomatic as of 08 May. One dead body still aboard. Disembarkation window closes Tuesday due to deteriorating coastal weather. Situation on board described as 'calm' by Oceanwide.

sites.name: USHUAIA / ARGENTINA ROUTE
sites.desc: Confirmed source investigation zone. Index case's 4-month itinerary (27 Nov 2025–01 Apr 2026) crossed Chile/Uruguay/Argentina; couple re-entered via Neuquén 31 Jan and also visited Misiones — both WHO-designated endemic zones. No hantavirus cases recorded in Tierra del Fuego since 1996, but Argentina reports 101 infections nationally since Jun 2025, roughly double prior year. Malbrán Institute team to depart for Ushuaia for rodent capture imminently.

sites.name: SAINT HELENA
sites.desc: 30 passengers disembarked 24 Apr before outbreak confirmed; index case body removed here. Case 2 (Dutch widow, PCR+) collapsed en route Johannesburg. Swiss confirmed case also disembarked here. Of 7 UK nationals: 2 self-isolating in UK, 4 remain on island, 1 traced outside UK. SA NICD contact-tracing 82 passengers + 6 crew from 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight ongoing.

sites.name: JOHANNESBURG
sites.desc: Case 2 (Dutch widow, PCR+) died on arrival 26 Apr. Case 3 (British guide Martin Anstee, 56, PCR+) treated at Johannesburg ICU — condition improving; subsequently transferred to Netherlands. SA NICD contact-traced 65+ contacts from 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight (82 pax + 6 crew); 42 of 62 traced as of 07 May. South African asymptomatic woman (briefly in Barcelona post-flight) now located and monitored in South Africa per Spain's Health Minister García.

sites.name: AMSTERDAM / NIJMEGEN
sites.desc: Three evacuees (06 May medevac from Cape Verde) in Dutch care: British Case 3 (56, confirmed) and Dutch crew member (41, confirmed) at Radboud UMC Nijmegen; 65-year-old German (asymptomatic contact) returned to Germany per WHO. Netherlands lab PCR-confirmed postmortem that German woman aboard ship also died of Andes virus. KLM flight attendant tested NEGATIVE 08 May — Tedros notes incubation period warrants continued monitoring. GGD tracing KL592 passengers. Two Dutch medical specialists remain aboard Hondius.

sites.name: LONDON
sites.desc: UKHSA confirmed 2 British nationals PCR+ (one in Netherlands, one treated South Africa) and flagged a 3rd suspected case — a British passenger on Tristan da Cunha who disembarked during 13–15 Apr stop. Two UK nationals who returned home independently self-isolating. UK chartering plane for ~20 British nationals from Tenerife; FCDO/UKHSA RDT pre-positioned. Asymptomatic returning Britons to isolate 45 days.

sites.name: PARIS
sites.desc: Eight French nationals identified as close contacts of confirmed case on 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight. One reporting mild symptoms, isolated pending PCR results. French health ministry coordinating diagnostics and quarantine measures.

sites.name: ZURICH
sites.desc: PCR-confirmed male passenger disembarked St Helena; self-presented to doctor after symptom onset, confirmed Andes virus at University Hospital Zurich. Wife (also on trip) asymptomatic and isolating. Swiss authorities conducting additional contact tracing.

sites.name: BERLIN
sites.desc: German woman died on board 02 May (fever/pneumonia onset 28 Apr) — Netherlands laboratory postmortem PCR now confirmed Andes virus, upgrading her from suspected to confirmed death. Asymptomatic 65-year-old German contact evacuated 06 May to Netherlands has returned to Germany per WHO. RKI contact tracing active.

sites.name: ALICANTE
sites.desc: 32-year-old woman hospitalized in negative-pressure isolation with symptoms consistent with hantavirus; seated briefly behind Dutch deceased on 25 Apr St Helena–Johannesburg flight. PCR results pending per Health Secretary Javier Padilla (08 May). Valencia Regional Health coordinating.

sites.name: TENERIFE
sites.desc: Hondius to anchor offshore Granadilla port 03:00–05:00 Sunday 10 May — will NOT dock pier-side. Passengers transfer by small boat to isolated cordoned quayside, then bus direct to airport. Evacuations begin Monday 11 May; window closes Tuesday due to worsening coastal weather. 14 Spanish passengers to military hospital (individual rooms, twice-daily temperature checks, PCR on arrival and Day 7). WHO/CDC/UKHSA/ECDC/RIVM teams pre-positioned.

sites.name: BARCELONA
sites.desc: South African woman (asymptomatic flight contact of Dutch deceased) spent approximately one week in Barcelona before returning to South Africa. Located and confirmed asymptomatic by Spain's Health Minister García (08 May). Spanish and South African authorities monitoring; no local transmission identified.

sites.name: TRISTAN DA CUNHA
sites.desc: UKHSA confirmed suspected hantavirus case (08 May, BBC/CNN/Al Jazeera): British passenger who disembarked Hondius during 13–15 Apr stop; developed symptoms and sought medical advice. UKHSA assessing; spouse isolating. 4 islanders who traveled via Hondius to St Helena also being traced. Patient currently on island per BBC reporting.

sites.name: SINGAPORE
sites.desc: Two male residents (aged 67 and 65) isolated in government facility; both disembarked Hondius at St Helena, flew via Johannesburg, returned 02–07 May. One presenting mild rhinorrhea, second asymptomatic. PCR test results pending. CDA: public risk in Singapore low.

sites.name: ONTARIO
sites.desc: Two Ontario residents self-isolating — Hondius passengers who returned home. Four Canadians total remain aboard vessel awaiting Tenerife evacuation. PHAC coordinating monitoring.

sites.name: QUEBEC
sites.desc: One Quebec resident self-isolating — not a Hondius passenger but shared homebound flight with two Canadian Hondius disembarkees. Asymptomatic; PHAC monitoring active.

sites.name: ARIZONA
sites.desc: ADHS monitoring one returning passenger under 42-day observation. Asymptomatic as of 08 May. Part of 7-person domestic US monitoring cohort across 5 states. CDC notified ADHS 05 May; medical director assessed public risk as very low. CDC Level-3 team deployed to Tenerife; second team to Offutt AFB Nebraska.

sites.name: CALIFORNIA
sites.desc: CDPH coordinating with local health officials to monitor returning Hondius travelers. No California residents reported ill or infected as of 08 May. 17 Americans still aboard ship to transit Tenerife to Nebraska quarantine via CDC-escorted State Dept charter using specialized biocontainment aircraft.

sites.name: GEORGIA
sites.desc: Georgia DPH monitoring two residents who returned from Hondius. Both in good health with no signs of infection as of 08 May. Following CDC recommendations.

sites.name: TEXAS
sites.desc: Texas DSHS monitoring two returning Hondius passengers. Both asymptomatic. Part of 7-person US domestic monitoring cohort across 5 states.

sites.name: VIRGINIA
sites.desc: VDH monitoring one returning Hondius passenger. Asymptomatic. President Trump stated 08 May the US situation is 'very much, we hope, under control.' CDC classified response as Level-3 (lowest emergency activation tier).

sites.name: NEW JERSEY
sites.desc: NJ health authorities monitoring two individuals with potential post-disembarkation exposure to a Hondius passenger. Neither symptomatic as of 08 May.

sites.name: NEBRASKA
sites.desc: Nebraska Medicine / UNMC National Quarantine Unit and Biocontainment Unit fully staffed and activated. CDC team deployed to Offutt AFB Bellevue to support arriving passengers. 17 American Hondius passengers to arrive via CDC-escorted State Dept biocontainment charter from Tenerife following Sunday docking. NQU previously activated for Ebola and COVID-19.

sites.name: MANILA
sites.desc: 38 Filipino crew members aboard Hondius; Philippines DOH confirmed none are currently ill as of 08 May. In close coordination with vessel operator and international authorities. Monitoring continues pending Tenerife disembarkation.

sites.name: DUBLIN
sites.desc: Two Irish nationals confirmed aboard Hondius per RTE (08 May). Irish Dept of Health coordinating with ECDC and WHO; returning Irish nationals to quarantine in Ireland. Irish passengers included in ECDC EU/EEA nationals briefing.

sites.name: PRAIA
sites.desc: Hondius anchored off Praia 03–06 May; departed 19:15 local 06 May for Tenerife. Three medevac patients evacuated here 06 May before transfer to Netherlands. Cape Verde assessed unable to handle full passenger evacuation — basis for WHO requesting Tenerife docking. Argentine biological material and diagnostic reagents dispatched to Cape Verde among five recipient countries.
